name: Nivolumab (PD-1 checkpoint inhibitor)

institution.provenance: StewardMD draft decision-support protocol (experimental, owner/device test only; not clinically activated)

supportiveCare: PD-1 checkpoint inhibitor for relapsed/refractory classical Hodgkin lymphoma.
Monitor for immune-related adverse events (thyroid, hepatitis, pneumonitis, colitis, endocrinopathies); manage with corticosteroids per severity.
Flat-dose schedule; 240 mg every 2 weeks or 480 mg every 4 weeks are interchangeable options.
monitoring: thyroid, liver, and metabolic panels before dosing
assessment for immune-related adverse events at each visit

drugs.name: Nivolumab
drugs.notes: Nivolumab 240 mg IV flat dose on day 1 every 14 days (alternative 480 mg every 28 days). Monitor for immune-related adverse events. Standard dosing (NCCN / DeVita general reference).
